title: Jingle Bells · Piano nỉ
heard: v7: "bản 7c hay nhất" (7c the best); then, to change in 7c: "kết bài gọn hơn" (the end tidier), "thêm một màu nhạc cụ" (one more colour of instrument), and the strings "đoạn sau nhỏ hơn chút" (a little softer later on)
about: v8a: as v7c (the strings Composer's Assistant 2 wrote), the end tidier: from the tune's last note every written part holds its tones of the last chord, dying away with the piano's (held_end; 7c's strings went on with little figures); the strings about 2 dB softer through the last verse (written_swell 0.57 and 0.74 for 0.75 and 1.0: expression's level goes as its square); and one more colour, written by the model over the last refrain hearing the piano and 7c's strings, each as its own instrument: the flute (plan colour-flute, take 2 of 3: a line of its own under the tune an octave up, its notes the chords' own, C sharp over A7; take 1 doubled the tune, take 3 was busy and sounded against the strings 11 % of its time).
